{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Keldabe anchoring bend''' was a distinctive and complex knot used to fasten or attach objects. Unique to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture,<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> the knot's design was named for the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], the traditional [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and the knowledge of how to tie the Keldabe anchoring bend was primarily restricted to Mandalorians. However, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were also familiar with the Keldabe anchoring bend, due to the influences of their Mandalorian [[Clone template/Legends|progenitor]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], and the Mandalorian training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''.<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Keldabe anchoring bend first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the third entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels. Entitled [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], the novel was [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 30]], [[2007]].
